caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a hinged lid and stands on four rounded, bun-shaped feet. The chest is primarily dark brown or black, with a slightly lighter brown top surface. The front and side panels are decorated with floral and leaf motifs in muted shades of red, yellow, green, and brown. The front panel features symmetrical floral designs radiating from a stylized central stem, while the right side also has a smaller, similar floral motif. The chest has two small round knobs on the front, likely serving as handles for a drawer at the bottom. The background is plain and light beige, with no additional objects present. The artist’s signature, “Bernard Krieger,” is faintly visible in the lower left corner.
title: Chest
